description: This Dart file defines a Flutter screen called ReportsScreen that displays daily and weekly attendance summaries with interactive date pickers, data fetching, and responsive layout. It uses provider for state management and custom UI components for buttons and empty states.

classes.name: ReportsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays daily and weekly attendance reports with date pickers and fetch buttons.

classes.name: _ReportsScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing user interaction and UI updates for ReportsScreen.

methods.name: _fetchDaily
methods.description: Triggers fetching of daily report data.

methods.name: _fetchWeekly
methods.description: Triggers fetching of weekly report data.
